title: Magtheridon's Lair
body: Magtheridon's Lair is the deepest vault beneath Hellfire Citadel, a great round chamber where the pit lord Magtheridon, once master of Outland, is held fast in bonds of shadow. Five Hellfire channelers stand about him, never pausing in the work that keeps him bound, and five Manticron cubes stand around the chamber's edge. He rages at his jailers without end, swearing he will crush Illidan and reclaim Outland as his own.

title: Magtheridon
body: Magtheridon is a pit lord of the Burning Legion, and for a time he was master of Outland, ruling from the Black Temple until Illidan Stormrage and his allies cast him down. Chained beneath Hellfire Citadel, he has lost none of his pride: he scorns his jailers as leeches, tells them to take his blood and choke on it, and calls Illidan an arrogant fool.

parts.body: With Magtheridon dead the manufactory beneath the citadel stopped its grim work, and the source of the fel orc army Illidan raised there was gone. The Legion's siege of the citadel no longer served any purpose.
